data_objects.name: ephemeris_records
data_objects.meaning: Time-indexed ephemeris-like records containing a Julian-date value, a TDB calendar-date rendering, and three Cartesian coordinate components.

variables.name: JDTDB
variables.meaning: Julian Date expressed on the TDB time scale.

variables.name: Calendar Date (TDB)
variables.meaning: Calendar-date and time representation of the ephemeris instant on the TDB time scale.

variables.name: X
variables.meaning: X component of a Cartesian position vector; reference frame, origin, and distance unit are not stated.

variables.name: Y
variables.meaning: Y component of a Cartesian position vector; reference frame, origin, and distance unit are not stated.

variables.name: Z
variables.meaning: Z component of a Cartesian position vector; reference frame, origin, and distance unit are not stated.

variables.name: Unnamed: 5
variables.meaning: Unlabeled trailing field with no stated semantic role.

structure.description: Each row represents one ephemeris instant; JDTDB and Calendar Date (TDB) are two time representations for that instant, while X, Y, and Z form a position vector.
Records are ordered by increasing ephemeris time.

uncertainties: The observed body, coordinate origin, coordinate frame, and distance unit are not specified.
The unlabeled trailing column has no documented interpretation.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the time labels, coordinate labels, and formatting visible in train.csv.
